# SERVICES AGREEMENT (synthetic test document)

This Services Agreement is made between Example Telematics Co., a limited liability company registered in Riyadh ("Customer"), and Vendor Systems Ltd., a company registered in Riyadh ("Vendor").

1. **Services.** Vendor will implement and host the fleet-analytics platform described in Schedule 1 for a fee of SAR 1,800,000 per year, payable quarterly in advance.
2. **Delay penalty.** If Vendor fails to meet any milestone in Schedule 2, Vendor shall pay Customer a penalty of 10% of the total contract value per week of delay, payable irrespective of any loss suffered by Customer. The parties agree that this penalty is a genuine pre-estimate and is not subject to reduction by any court or tribunal.
3. **Limitation of liability.** Vendor shall not be liable to Customer for any loss whatsoever arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, including loss caused by Vendor's gross negligence, and in no event shall Vendor's aggregate liability exceed SAR 100,000.
4. **Assignment.** Vendor may assign or novate this Agreement in whole or in part to any third party without the consent of Customer. Customer may not assign this Agreement.
5. **Claims.** Any claim by Customer under this Agreement must be brought within six (6) months of the event giving rise to it, failing which it is waived.
6. **Late payment.** Overdue amounts bear interest at 8% per annum from the due date until payment.
7. **Data.** Vendor may use Customer's vehicle telemetry data to improve Vendor's products and services and may transfer such data to Vendor's affiliates outside the Kingdom.
8. **Term.** Three (3) years from the Effective Date, renewing automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives ninety (90) days' written notice before the end of the then-current term.
9. **Governing law and disputes.** This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Disputes shall be referred to the competent courts in Riyadh.
10. **Language.** This Agreement is executed in English only.
